math_checks.claim: The orbit count is compatible with the stated cyclic normalizer.
math_checks.work: For a transitive action of finite W on the lines, orbit–stabilizer gives the number of lines as |W|/|N_W(D)|. If the asserted generator c has order h, N_W(D)=<c> gives |W|/h, matching card(W)/h.
math_checks.limit: This checks the algebraic implication only. The order of c, finiteness, transitivity, and the normalizer theorem were not proved from this isolated page or checked externally.

math_checks.type: one implication proved from the written commuting-action assertion
math_checks.claim: Two lines in one orbit of the commuting unit-group action have the same W-stabilizer.
math_checks.work: For g in the acting group and D a line, w(gD)=g(wD). If wD=D then w(gD)=gD. Applying g inverse gives the reverse containment of stabilizers. Thus Stab_W(gD)=Stab_W(D).
math_checks.limit: The converse stated in the NB does not follow merely from commutation; it was read but not independently proved. Freeness, existence, and uniqueness assertions were likewise not verified.
